scope_statement: TOY, hard ceiling. PS-R3 only (n=7187, n_e=56, n_2=128, dup=1, N=7168, k 2..26, m=17). One defect class (V3, last-block-window-read-early), one injection point (decode_blocks's block window, LAST BLOCK ONLY). Shards 5000 and 8002 INDIVIDUALLY -- NO cross-shard pooling anywhere in this script. Trial indices [30000,75000) retained per shard; the discarded prefix [0,30000) is COMPUTED, never skipped, because it carries the disjointness proof. NOTHING here is a statement about HQC, A17, A5, any decoding-failure rate, or any standardized parameter set.
observations_only_note: THE EXECUTOR CONCLUDES NOTHING. batch.yaml's frozen four-branch reading rule is NOT applied here; it is the Coordinator's to apply at the ledger archive.
